A B2B SaaS platform (Series D) — Technology & SaaS engagement delivered by a 12-person team over 9 months, US scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Deploy frequency up but incidents ate roadmap; error budgets decorative.
LLM features shipped without cost telemetry or eval gates; margin diluting.
SOC 2 evidence manual; enterprise deals stalled on security reviews.

blocks.x: The platform program delivered golden paths with SLO discipline and DORA instrumentation; the AI feature factory wired evaluations, guardrails and cost telemetry into the release train; and compliance-as-code produced continuous SOC 2 evidence — security reviews passed in days.
A B2B SaaS platform (Series D) uses the standard Achala delivery pattern — nothing bespoke about the governance, everything bespoke about the design. That split is deliberate.

items: Written up as a case study: the baseline, the measured outcome and the method, with client identity withheld by agreement.
You can read the shape of this engagement on the case page: baseline locked early, outcome measured against it, method available under NDA.

blocks.x: Towers: Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering, Applied AI & Generative AI, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: Fleet Management System, Driisti Smart Vision Glasses, Tele Medicine Platform.

items: What moved unchanged between sectors, and why it was safe to move — stated plainly.
What does not transfer between estates, and the adaptation it needs — named before the pilot, not after.

blocks.x: Anonymity is contractual; the measurement discipline is not — the same gates and evidence standards apply on every engagement.
